messages:
Morgan: Addressed the race-condition you flagged, added a unit + stress test, and adjusted the allocator timeout. CI passes locally. Can someone do a quick scan? @Sam @Lee

Jules: thanks — will take a look in a few. quick q: did you consider the overflow case when seq_len > 2048?

Morgan: yep — added a guard and a test. also squashed the WIP tests. pushed: `git push --force origin fix/race-ci`

ci-bot: CI started for commit 3a9f2b — running unit tests and integration smoke

Morgan: also updated the PR description with the fallback behavior and a short perf note.

Lee: skimmed the diff, logic looks good. left one tiny nit inline: `alloc_timeout_ms` -> `alloc_timeout_ms_default` for clarity. no blockers.

Sam: I'll take care of canary once we have 1 more approver. @Jules can you re-check the rename? if ok I'll merge and schedule a 30m canary.

Jules: checking now. small rename looks good to me, makes intent clearer. approving :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks — approving as well. merging in ~10m unless someone objects :clock1:

Morgan: thanks all :tada: canary deployed, monitoring for 20m. no regressions so far.

Sam: great — promoting to stable in 30. :rocket:
